'''Camm''' was a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who was part of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Piloc]]'s [[Squad/Legends|squad]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Camm was shot by the rest of Piloc's squad on the orders of Piloc, who was an incompetent leader.<ref name="TOR" />
